admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: On the fifth the member changed two display preferences. Reminders now play a low bell instead of staying silent, and pages now show a sand colour in place of plain white. The steward can see that a preference was changed, but not which values were picked. This entry stays in the settings history for twelve months.
